BiblicalUsage: Hektos means sixth, and the sixth hour and the sixth month mark two of the greatest days in the Bible. In Luke 1:26 the angel Gabriel is sent in the sixth month to Mary, in John 19:14 it is the sixth hour when Pilate brings Jesus out, in Matthew 27:45 darkness covers the land from the sixth hour, and in Revelation 6:12 the sixth seal is opened and the sun becomes black.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sixth hour is the hour God chose for both the beginning and the end: the announcement to Mary and the darkness on the cross, and the seal that will open at the last. The same number carries the birth announcement and the death darkness, and both belong to the same story.
